title: Audit queries and provenance-gap detection
note: The interesting mutations are A2, A3 and A7: they do not break a chain, they make an INCOMPLETE chain read as complete. A hole in provenance is indistinguishable from a fabrication nobody noticed, so an auditor that cannot see holes is worse than none -- it produces confident reassurance.

mutations.name: A1_audit_accepts_a_tampered_log
mutations.rationale: an audit produces a confident answer about a document that may have been rewritten -- worse than refusing

mutations.name: A2_missing_records_not_reported
mutations.rationale: a VERIFIED task with no evidence record reads as fully supported

mutations.name: A3_self_verification_not_flagged
mutations.find: if executed_by is not None and executed_by == verified_by:
mutations.rationale: a log written outside the gate showing an executor verifying itself passes the audit

mutations.name: A4_redaction_removed
mutations.rationale: credential-shaped fields leave the module intact and land in reports

mutations.name: A5_separators_not_flattened
mutations.rationale: bearer_token and api-key slip the net, because _ is a word character

mutations.name: A6_artifact_traced_by_any_string
mutations.rationale: artifacts are traced by name rather than by content

mutations.name: A7_completeness_always_true
mutations.rationale: every chain reports as complete, including the ones with holes
